content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe markets itself as a seamless payment solution, but its services are only available in 46 countries out of 195 globally. This exclusion leaves many creators unable to leverage its advantages, such as in-depth analytics and easy integration. PayPal, while more widely available, comes with its own drawbacks, including account suspensions that can hold funds for up to 180 days without an appeal. Alternatives like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have similar restrictions, often limiting access based on geographic location. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, provided by COREMERCH, enables creators to build their own digital stores using free and accessible tools. This approach not only bypasses geographical limitations but also empowers creators to own and manage their businesses independently.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's restrictive operational model makes it untenable for creators in countries like Zimbabwe or Cameroon, where no support is available. PayPal's policies can be equally frustrating, as many users in Africa and South Asia find their accounts frozen without warning. Platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also impose geographic restrictions, often leading to a frustrating cycle of searching for alternatives. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is explicitly designed to serve creators who have been locked out of conventional payment processors. By employing tools like NOWPayments for crypto transactions, COREMERCH offers a robust solution that operates independently of the user's location, ensuring that creators can sell their products without fear of discrimination or exclusion.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment processing speed with Stripe and PayPal can be frustrating, often taking several days to settle funds, which can impact cash flow for creators. Both platforms also charge substantial fees, which can cut deeply into profits, especially for small transactions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification through NOWPayments, with minimal fees of just 0.5%. This not only speeds up the payment process—allowing creators to receive funds instantly—but also reduces the overall cost of doing business. By leveraging low-fee networks like BSC or Solana, creators can maximize their earnings without the burden of high transaction fees common with traditional payment processors.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to take control of their sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the critical downsides of using platforms like Stripe or PayPal is the lack of ownership over your digital assets and customer data. When transactions are handled by these platforms, the creator often loses access and control over vital business information. Additionally, delays in product delivery can occur as these platforms control the transaction flow. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators maintain complete ownership of their digital products, customer information, and sales data. The automated delivery systems set up through tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensure that products are delivered instantly upon purchase, creating a seamless experience for both the creator and the customer.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right infrastructure depends on your unique needs and the complexity of your offerings. For those just starting out, the Sovereign Starter Stack from COREMERCH is an excellent choice, allowing for a quick setup at a low cost. If you have more extensive needs, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a more robust solution with enhanced capabilities and support. However, regardless of which stack you choose, the underlying principle remains the same: you are not renting a service but owning your infrastructure outright. This architectural sovereignty allows you to operate independently of any restrictions imposed by external platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, the best alternative is to adopt sovereign commerce infrastructure like that offered by COREMERCH. This allows you to set up your own digital store with automatic crypto payment processing. By using tools like NOWPayments, you can manage transactions seamlessly, regardless of your location.
No more account freezes or suspensions; own your digital assets fully.
